basics.name: Erfan Eivazi
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building and evolving backend-oriented enterprise systems and web applications.
Strong background in C#/.NET and Node.js, with a focus on software architecture, clean code, refactoring, maintainability, and API-driven systems.
Experienced across the full SDLC in Agile/Scrum teams, with hands-on expertise in GIS, data-intensive applications, distributed systems, and DevOps collaboration.

work.summary: Engineering software company developing web-based systems for gas network simulation, forecasting, monitoring, and analysis.
highlights: Developed backend systems for gas network simulation, gas consumption forecasting, and transmission-network monitoring for the National Iranian Gas Company.
Designed and evolved backend services using C#/.NET, applying Clean Architecture, CQRS, microservices, and asynchronous messaging with RabbitMQ.
Improved long-term maintainability through code reviews, Clean Code practices, technical-debt management, and continuous refactoring, including architectural redesign of core packages.
Built GIS and data-processing solutions using OGC standards, WFS/WMS/TMS, OpenLayers, GeoServer, web scraping, dynamic QueryBuilder-based reporting, and Excel automation.
Contributed across the SDLC in Agile/Scrum teams, including requirements analysis, technical design, frontend collaboration, DevOps support, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.
Techs: C# | .NET Core | SQL Server | Microservices | NestJS | Angular | GIS

Designed and developed ParadiseHub, a multi-branch CRM and workspace management platform supporting 11 user roles, rental plans, reservations, online payments, wallet transactions, financial reporting, and multi-stage application workflows.
Built advanced query-building and search capabilities over Elasticsearch for large volumes of unstructured and filtered data.
Contributed as a Backend Developer to HR and recruitment platforms, including IranHR and a job-search engine, as well as mobile application projects.
Techs: JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | MongoDB | Elasticsearch
Built a web-scraping pipeline to collect job postings from three major Iranian job websites and developed a searchable job-search application.
Ranked first in the bootcamp and was invited to join FuTech Group as a software developer.
Techs: HTML | CSS | JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | MySQL | Git

work.summary: Embedded systems and software-hardware integration projects.
highlights: Developed control and monitoring software for interactive installations, radiation-monitoring systems, access-control prototypes, and automated parking-gate systems.
Worked across embedded programming, hardware communication, sensor integration, real-time monitoring, and software UI development using C, C#, AVR, Arduino, Windows Forms, and RS-232.
